claims.claim: We also deals in all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: The witness report only shows a motorcycle engine/upper assembly; it does not confirm the seller’s business scope or inventory beyond this item.

risks.risk: Exact make/model and compatibility are unknown, so the engine/assembly may not fit the buyer’s motorcycle or may be the wrong variant.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate/stamping (engine number) and any visible model/part number on the airbox/ECU/wiring label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unidentified motorcycle engine/upper assembly with compatibility risk (worst-case: parts may not match).

risks.risk: Engine completeness is uncertain: the assembly appears partially disassembled and may be missing covers, sensors, hoses, fasteners, or internal components.
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo showing every included component, plus a photo of the assembly fully assembled/complete from multiple angles.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/partially disassembled (worst-case: missing key parts).

risks.risk: Working condition is unknown (no test): compression/health, whether it runs, and internal damage cannot be confirmed from surface visuals.
risks.proof: A short video of a cold start/run test (or compression test results) showing the engine running smoothly and any warning lights/idle behavior.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-tested/unverified working condition (worst-case: not working).

risks.risk: Leak/gasket condition is unknown: oil/fuel/coolant leaks and gasket integrity can’t be confirmed from dusty/grimy external appearance.
risks.proof: Photos of the underside and mating surfaces (gasket areas) plus a wipe-clean test showing no fresh leaks after running (or a leak check video).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing reseal/gasket replacement (worst-case: leaks).

risks.risk: Electrical/ECU/immobilizer and wiring completeness is unknown; missing ECU, sensors, or connectors can make the assembly unusable.
risks.proof: Clear photos of ECU/ignition module (if present), sensor connectors, and wiring harness ends; include part numbers/labels.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing/uncertain electronics (worst-case: electrical components not included or incompatible).

risks.risk: Surface rust/grime suggests age or poor storage; corrosion may affect mounting points, fasteners, or internal passages.
risks.proof: Close-ups of critical mounting points, bolt threads, and any exposed internal ports; plus a video showing corrosion severity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible corrosion (worst-case: parts require cleaning/repair).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the engine number/ID plate and any part numbers on the airbox/ECU/wiring labels.
Show a complete inventory photo: every included sensor, hose, cover, fastener, and connector laid out and counted.
Provide a short video of the engine running (or compression test results) and confirm what is included for operation.
Upload close-ups of gasket/mating surfaces and underside areas to check for leaks/corrosion.
Confirm whether ECU/ignition/immobilizer components and matching wiring connectors are included; share clear photos of each.
response.reason: The witness report identifies the item as a motorcycle engine/upper assembly that appears partially disassembled, with unknown make/model and unverified working condition. A worst-case price can be set for an unidentified, incomplete, non-tested assembly; seller’s general spare-parts claim doesn’t change the item’s condition.
